extDescription.message: Family web filter for home PCs. Works with the WebFilter app on this computer to filter websites and limit browsing time.
extDescription.description: Manifest description and store summary; at most 132 characters.

langCode.description: BCP 47 code of this file; set on <html lang>.

textDirection.description: Text direction of this file: ltr or rtl.

reason_allowed_rule.message: This site is allowed by a rule.

reason_allowed_category.message: This site is in an allowed category.

reason_allowed_homework.message: This site is allowed in homework mode.

reason_blocked_category.message: This site is in a category your parents blocked.

reason_blocked_not_in_allowlist.message: Only sites your parents approved can be opened, and this one isn't on the list yet.

reason_blocked_time_window.message: Browsing isn't allowed at this hour.

reason_blocked_daily_limit.message: You've used all of today's browsing time.

reason_blocked_homework.message: Homework mode is on: only learning sites are open right now.

reason_blocked_ip_literal.message: Sites can't be opened by their numeric address.

reason_blocked_youtube_unknown.message: We couldn't tell which YouTube channel this video belongs to, so it's blocked.

reason_blocked_youtube_off.message: YouTube is turned off for you.

reason_blocked_service_unavailable.message: The filtering service isn't running, so only always-allowed sites can be opened.

reason_blocked_app_network.message: This app isn't allowed to use the internet.

reason_redirect_youtube_home.message: YouTube's home page and search aren't available. Pick one of your channels.

reason_blocked_image_search.message: Image search is turned off for you.

reason_blocked_jump.message: The site you were on tried to open another site.

reason_blocked_youtube_shorts.message: YouTube Shorts are turned off for you.

reason_blocked_baseline_adult.message: Adult site — blocked by the family's baseline protection.

reason_redirect_youtube_channel_search.message: On YouTube you can search for channels only. Here are the channels for your search.

reason_failclosed.message: WebFilter isn't connected to the filtering service yet, so browsing is blocked. This page will open by itself as soon as it connects.
reason_failclosed.description: Static fail-closed ruleset: no profile from the service yet.

overrideButton.description: Jump block page, teens and parents: opens the site once; for a teen, the parents see that it was opened.

baselineHint.message: A parent can turn this protection off in the WebFilter admin app, on the Settings page (Baseline protection for parents and adults).
baselineHint.description: Block page of a parent's own account (PROTECTION-SPEC §13): how to turn the baseline protection off.

requestYouTubeButton.message: Ask my parents to approve this channel

result_created.message: Your request was sent to your parents. If they approve, the page will open by itself.

result_merged.message: You already asked for this. The request is waiting for your parents.

result_rate_limited.message: You've sent a lot of requests in the last hour. Try again later.

result_cooldown.message: Your parents said no to this a little while ago. You can ask again in an hour.

result_queued.message: Your request was saved and will reach your parents when the computer is connected again.

result_unavailable.message: Requests can't be sent right now because the filtering service isn't running.

result_error.message: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

result_waiting.message: Your request is waiting for your parents.

decision_denied.message: Your parents said no to this request.

timeupBodyLimit.message: You've used all of today's browsing time.

timeupBodyWindow.message: Browsing isn't allowed at this hour. You can browse again in your next time window.

timeupAlwaysAllowed.message: Sites that are always allowed still work.

myChannelsIntro.message: These are the channels your parents approved. YouTube's home page and search aren't available.

myChannelsEmpty.message: No channels have been approved yet. You can ask your parents to add some.

statusInertDetail.message: WebFilter filters only when the WebFilter app installs it through the browser policy. Here it is inactive and blocks nothing.

statusServiceDetail.message: Filtering and time limits are active.

statusBaselineDetail.message: The family's baseline protection is on (set in the WebFilter admin app). Nothing of your browsing is recorded.
statusBaselineDetail.description: Popup of a parent's own account (PROTECTION-SPEC §13).

statusHostDetail.message: Working in limited mode until the service is back.

statusDisconnectedDetail.message: Browsing is blocked until WebFilter on this computer responds.

searchesVisible.message: Your searches are visible to your parents
searchesVisible.description: Shown while the search-term log is on (PROTECTION-SPEC §9).

adsBlocked.description: Shown while the ad-server ruleset is on (PROTECTION-SPEC §12).

mode_baseline.description: A parent's own account with the family's baseline protection (PROTECTION-SPEC §13).

minutesValue.description: count: a number of minutes greater than 1.

notifyDenied.message: Your parents said no to your request.
